name: design-choice-gives-previews
about: A design choice whose options the agent drew as images is recorded with each option's image in previews, given at once or after the record's answer says it has none.
prompt: Task: restyle the cards on the dashboard. You made a mockup of each of four card styles and saved them in this checkout: .scratch/cards/flat.png, .scratch/cards/outlined.png, .scratch/cards/raised.png and .scratch/cards/glass.png. You recommend raised, because the cards sit on a busy background. I have to choose one style before you build it. Ask me.

name: design-choice-without-pictures-records-once
about: A design choice between two ways to build something, with nothing drawn, is recorded once with no previews: the record's answer that it has none asks only when the agent made something to show.
prompt: Task: add search to the product API. Before you build it, I have to choose how: Postgres full-text search, or a new Elasticsearch cluster. You have not built or drawn either one. You recommend Postgres, because the catalog has under 50,000 products. Ask me.
